observed_effect: The audit produced a concrete, evidence-backed duplicate-avoidance conclusion: the durable history prevents duplicate frontier-cell experiments (each resolved cell is recorded once with a terminal status, and agents 01-03 executed three distinct tasks with no equivalent re-test). The single near-duplicate found is a pre-campaign orphaned implementation (research/checks/momentum_sweep.py, no artifact, referenced nowhere) which is now explicitly annotated as superseded so a future agent will not re-run it as a new experiment. The minimal novelty guard (frontier table terminal statuses + Learning rule 2 + exact-task_id dedup) is judged SUFFICIENT for the current campaign; no controller/process mechanism change is warranted.
uncertainty_targeted: Does the durable history adequately prevent repeating equivalent experiments when a frontier cell is already resolved?
uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: established from durable evidence that resolved frontier cells are each recorded once with terminal status and that no equivalent experiment was executed twice across campaign agents 01-03; identified and annotated the single near-duplicate (research/checks/momentum_sweep.py) as superseded so it will not be re-run. Not eliminated: the controller has no semantic novelty enforcement, so prevention still depends on the frontier artifact and agent discipline, and a future near-duplicate phrasing could slip through.
research_result: PROCESS (no market hypothesis tested; out of scope): the minimal novelty guard is RETAINED as sufficient. Concrete duplicate-avoidance evidence: (a) the LEARNING_STATE frontier table lists each resolved signal-class cell exactly once with a terminal status; (b) the campaign selector (campaign_controller.select_task/load_queue) deduplicates only exact task_id and otherwise ranks OPEN tasks by ordinal priority, with no semantic novelty check; (c) agents 01-03 executed three distinct tasks (P-001, R-001, P-002) with zero equivalent re-tests; (d) exactly one near-duplicate implementation exists (research/checks/momentum_sweep.py vs the admitted momentum_lookback_sweep.py + momentum_longer_horizon.py), it is pre-campaign, has no artifact, and is referenced by no durable record, and is now annotated superseded. Conclusion: the durable history adequately prevents repeating equivalent experiments at the operative frontier-cell level, and a minimal novelty guard is sufficient; no code-level guard is warranted without an observed executed duplicate. This is a process judgment from durable evidence, not from agent confidence or execution success.
